name: Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for procurement and strategic sourcing, covering purchase requisitions (PR), RFQ/RFP bidding, purchase orders (PO), 3-way matching, supplier onboarding, supplier scorecards, and contract lifecycle management.

checklists.name: Procurement & Sourcing Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for PR approvals, competitive RFQ bidding, PO issuance, and 3-way matching.

items.statement: Purchase Requisitions are approved per Delegation of Authority (DoA) thresholds prior to PO creation.
Competitive RFQ/RFP bidding includes at least 3 qualified supplier quotations for spend above threshold.
New suppliers undergo compliance screening, tax ID verification, and bank account validation.
Goods Receipt Notes (GRN) record physical inspection, accepted quantity, and damaged items.
Vendor invoice price and quantity match PO and GRN within approved tolerance limits (3-Way Match).

reviewGates.name: Procurement Director Sourcing Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Head of Procurement confirms that competitive sourcing, vendor evaluation, and 3-way matching rules are satisfied.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the procurement documentation confirm competitive bidding and 3-way match validation?

obligationDefinitions.title: Supplier performance scorecards must be refreshed on a recurring cadence
obligationDefinitions.description: A supplier's risk/performance scorecard used in sourcing decisions must reflect recent delivery, quality, and compliance performance, not the score recorded at initial qualification.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every active supplier's scorecard is refreshed within the declared cadence.
obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has this supplier's performance scorecard been refreshed within the required cadence?
